headline: Nigeria and Russia Sign Customs Deal to Streamline Bilateral Trade
summary: The Nigeria Customs Service signed a bilateral cooperation agreement with Russia's Federal Customs Service to enhance trade facilitation, intelligence sharing, and enforcement.
why: Customs trade facilitation agreements lower administrative friction and regulatory obstacles for cross-border import-export operations.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Bilateral customs accords enhance trade efficiency and joint enforcement standards.
